title: Observer Intake Envelope
description: Universal intake format for all observations entering the Hearthgate Observer. Covers canon events, temporal readings, pattern analyses, glyph casts, news digests, Arcsweep measurements, and external signals. Sources declare what they observed — the Observer owns the routing decision. No source may specify destination_datasets.

envelope_id.description: Unique ID assigned at intake. Sources may suggest an ID; the Observer assigns the final one.

received_at.description: UTC timestamp when the Observer received this envelope.

source_id.description: Identifier of the system or agent that submitted this observation. e.g. arcsweep/v0.4, nocturne-observer/0.1, runa/0.1, external/news-digest.

source_kind.description: What kind of source produced this observation. Drives the initial routing heuristic.

evidence_class.description: Epistemic standing of the evidence in this envelope.

content_kind.description: What the content is — independent of source.

utc_start.description: UTC start of the observation window.

utc_end.description: UTC end of the observation window. Null if ongoing.

ongoing.description: True if this observation is still in progress.

duration_note.description: Human-readable extent note when precise timestamps are unavailable.

canon_effect.description: Whether and how this observation changes the canon record.

consent_scope.description: Consent scope inherited from Hearthfire consent model. Drives DEEP dataset eligibility.

confidence.description: Source's confidence in this observation. 1.0 = fully verified. Does not override the Observer's own epistemic classification.

payload.description: The actual observation content. Structure varies by source_kind. The Observer classifies and routes — it does not require a fixed payload shape.

notes.description: Optional free-text note from the source.

not.description: Sources may not specify routing destinations. The Observer owns all routing decisions.
